page_title: BAR 4-1 ESP | Barcelona v Espanyol 11/04/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's it for today, Alejandro Hernandez has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+2' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Urko Gonzalez (Espanyol) was quite harsh and Alejandro Hernandez didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

89' 4 - 1 Goal! Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) shows good awareness inside the box as he latches on to a brilliant pass and fires a first-time shot into the bottom right corner. Frenkie de Jong assisted in the goal. 4:1.
87' 3 - 1 Goal 3:1! Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) taps home from close range after the rebound fell kindly into his path.
87' Marko Dmitrovic displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
85' A great run by Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) gets him into the box, but his powerful shot is bravely blocked by a defender.
84' Frenkie de Jong (Barcelona) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Fermín.
83' Fernando Calero (Espanyol) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Alejandro Hernandez had an easy-decision to make.
82' The corner is swung in but Espanyol can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
82' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Pere Milla (Espanyol) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
82' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Espanyol.
80' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Pol Lozano leaves the pitch and Charles Pickel (Espanyol) comes on.

80' Roberto Fernandez Jaen (Espanyol) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Barcelona.
77' The whipped in corner perfectly picks out Fernando Calero (Espanyol) near the penalty spot, but the ball comes off the top of his head and goes a mile over the bar.
77' The ball is out of play and Espanyol manage to earn a corner.
74' Substitution. Dani Olmo (Barcelona) on for Ferran Torres.
72' Fernando Calero (Espanyol) tries his luck but the attempt goes well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Barcelona.
71' Manolo Gonzalez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Ramon Terrats (Espanyol) replacing Exposito.
71' The substitution is prepared. Pere Milla (Espanyol) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Kike Garcia.
71' Espanyol seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
69' A great solo run by Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) took him deep inside the box, but his weak effort towards the bottom left corner was easily caught by Marko Dmitrovic.
69' Roberto Fernandez Jaen (Espanyol) jumps inside the box to meet the corner and aims a low header towards the right post, but the goalkeeper pulls off an astonishing save to deny him.
68' Corner kick. Espanyol will have an opportunity.
66' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Marko Dmitrovic.
64' The substitution has been made. Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) has replaced Alejandro Balde.
64' Hansi Flick has decided to substitute Gavi and he is replaced by Marcus Rashford (Barcelona).
64' Substitution. Cyril Ngonge is replaced by Ruben Sanchez (Espanyol).
64' A corner kick by Barcelona is thwarted by the well prepared Marko Dmitrovic (Espanyol).
63' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Barcelona.
62' Barcelona can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
61' Fermín (Barcelona) meets a cross inside the box, but his header is blocked by an opposing player. The ball is out of play. Barcelona win a corner kick.
59' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the top of the net, but Marko Dmitrovic has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
58' Alejandro Hernandez shows a yellow card to Pol Lozano (Espanyol) for his blatant foul.
56' 2 - 1 Pol Lozano (Espanyol) collects a rebound and hits it precisely into the bottom left corner.
54' Celebrations are cut short for Barcelona as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was offside!
54' That looked like an offside in the build-up play and the referee Alejandro Hernandez is going to take a look using VAR.
54' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Ferran Torres (Barcelona) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
54' Dangerous play by Fernando Calero (Espanyol). Alejandro Hernandez blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Barcelona.
53' Some neat passing and movement from Barcelona as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
51' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) tries to find Lamine Yamal, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
50' Kike Garcia (Espanyol) makes a run beyond the last defender, but he's offside.
49' Marc Casado (Barcelona) has tested the patience of referee Alejandro Hernandez and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
48' Barcelona take a short corner kick.
48' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) goes on a weaving run through the defence and gets within shooting range but his effort is blocked. The ball goes out of play. Barcelona are awarded a corner kick.
46' Manolo Gonzalez has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Roberto Fernandez Jaen (Espanyol) comes on the pitch for Tyrhys Dolan.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Gerard Martin comes off for Marc Casado (Barcelona).
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+4' Alejandro Hernandez has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+3' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Eric Garcia (Barcelona) was quite harsh and Alejandro Hernandez didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

45+2' Ronald Araujo (Barcelona) timed his run perfectly to connect with the resulting corner kick, but his finish from around the penalty spot was rather poor as it went way over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Espanyol.
45+2' The linesman points to the corner flag, Barcelona are going to take it.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
45' Cyril Ngonge (Espanyol) makes a bad challenge on his opponent and is booked by the referee.
45' Espanyol failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
43' Alejandro Hernandez has a clear sight and sees a foul from Eric Garcia (Barcelona).
42' Pedri (Barcelona) skips past the defender inside the box and blasts the ball at goal, but sends the effort high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Espanyol.
41' Barcelona have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

40' Fermín (Barcelona) gets to a rebound in front of goal and sends the ball towards the top right corner. However, he couldn't beat Marko Dmitrovic, who shows off his superb goalkeeping ability by pulling off a great save. Now Barcelona have a corner.
40' Eric Garcia (Barcelona) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the right side of the goal, but Marko Dmitrovic has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
38' Gerard Martin (Barcelona) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
37' Alejandro Hernandez blows his whistle and it's Cyril Ngonge (Espanyol) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
34' Exposito (Espanyol) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Alejandro Hernandez had an easy-decision to make.
32' Gavi (Barcelona) is shown a deserved yellow card for saying too much to the referee.
32' Omar El Hilali (Espanyol) is awarded a yellow card for a sharp discussion with the referee. He should relax or he could be sent off.
31' A decent effort by Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) from a close-range free kick! His attempt flies narrowly over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Espanyol will have a goal kick.
30' Pol Lozano (Espanyol) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Barcelona.

29' Barcelona slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
27' Tyrhys Dolan (Espanyol) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass. The ball goes out of play and Barcelona will have a goal kick.
25' 2 - 0 Goal! Lamine Yamal plays a pass to the feet of Ferran Torres (Barcelona), and he shoots into the bottom left corner from inside the box. It's 2:0.
24' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) is caught offside, but it was a really close call.
23' Wonderful movement by Barcelona. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
20' Carlos Romero (Espanyol) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Joan Garcia intercepts the ball.
19' Leandro Cabrera (Espanyol) commits a rough challenge and Alejandro Hernandez blows his whistle for a foul.
17' Fermín (Barcelona) aims a low effort to the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.
16' Alejandro Hernandez couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Kike Garcia (Espanyol) and blew his whistle.
14' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Carlos Romero (Espanyol). The ball is out of play. Espanyol will have a throw-in.
13' Kike Garcia (Espanyol) is the one to unleash a good effort towards the bottom left corner. His shot, however, is saved by the goalkeeper. What a save!
12' Barcelona keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
9' 1 - 0 The resulting corner is whipped in by Lamine Yamal and Ferran Torres (Barcelona) is left unmarked to plant a precise header into the top left corner. The score is 1:0.
9' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Barcelona will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
9' Ronald Araujo (Barcelona) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. Barcelona will take a corner kick.
8' Wow, what an escape. Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked.
6' Fermín (Barcelona) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Espanyol.

4' Exposito (Espanyol) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his strike wasn't accurate at all and the ball went well over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Barcelona will have a goal kick.
2' Barcelona are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out and the match is about to start. Barcelona will have the kick-off.
Alejandro Hernandez is introduced as the referee for today's match.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
